newsitem.title: ITALY: Italcementi slips after H1 96 results.
newsitem.headline: Italcementi slips after H1 96 results.

text.p: Shares in Italian building products group Italcementi fell in relatively heavy volume after it reported a heavy first half group loss, dealers said.

The group reported late Friday a consolidated loss of 46.5 billion lire for the first half of 1996 from a 82.1 billion lire profit, while the parent company profit fell to 5.7 billion lire from a 32.1 billion profit.
Dealers said that since the Milan bourse was closed for technical problems on Monday the shares were only now reacting to the first-half results.
At 1310 GMT, the shares were off 7.28 percent at 8,900 lire.
